card.name: Inside idioms with put, get, wipe
card.fires_on: Words in the middle of informal idioms or figures of speech in quoted speech or essays, such as "put it on the map", "put to the torch" and "wiped the floor with". It responds to the small word or verb that comes before the idiom's final part.

modes.label: Put idioms
modes.description: The word after "put" in a figurative phrase.
modes.example: Bell invented it, but Vail put<< it>> on the map.”

modes.label: Get or wipe phrases
modes.description: A verb or article partway through a colloquial expression in a quote.
modes.example: You guys wiped<< the>> floor with them!"

modes.label: Other idiom slots
modes.description: A word inside a casual phrase such as "made a botch of it" or "translate into".
modes.example: I did that and made a bot<<ch>> of it.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of casual sayings, like "put it on the map", before the saying is finished.
